name: Kitagami Kouji
source:
A middle-aged bachelor pushing forty. Preoccupied with work, his daily life consists of waking up, going to work, coming back home and going to sleep. Even on his days off he just idles away without doing anything... Possibly due to his serious and diligent attitude, he only lives to work. He is well aware that he will remain a virgin bachelor if things continue the way they are.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=835147]Getchu[/url]]
